$comment: S06 Open-Meteo climate projections (T054). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s06.yaml.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.meaning: om_cmip6_<lat>N_<lon>E, the cell the API snapped to (ERA5-Land 10 km when bias-corrected, the model grid when raw)

fields.name: model
fields.meaning: CMIP6 HighResMIP model from the series suffix, for example MRI_AGCM3_2_S

fields.name: scenario
fields.meaning: Always null: the API has no scenario parameter and names no SSP; the docs say only 'as close to RCP8.5 as possible within CMIP6' (T053 e04)

fields.name: bias_corrected
fields.meaning: true for the default linear bias correction onto ERA5-Land; false when disable_bias_correction=true was requested

fields.name: rain_mm
fields.meaning: precipitation_sum_<model> in mm per day, including snowfall

valid_at: the end of the GMT day
issued_at: null: a climate projection has no issue time and is not a forecast
missing: A model-day with any value missing becomes an all-null row with missing_reason out_of_coverage; negative rain gives quality_rejected
